title: Notion startup send fix
summary: Fixes Notion startup getting stuck with a half-written command list in the chat box, which then left every command as not run.
improved: If Notion stops accepting a long startup message part-way, PlazCode switches to sending it as a file straight away instead of waiting again.
fixed: Notion no longer leaves part of PlazCode's command list in the chat box with “Message was not confirmed” after Start Agent.
Commands no longer stay “not run” after that startup failure, because PlazCode clears its own leftover draft.
notes: Text you typed yourself is still never cleared.
Automated platform/browser regressions passed. This fix was not tested on a live Notion account.

sections.title: 🛠️ Notion startup fixed
items: **No half-written drafts:** if Notion stops accepting the long startup message, PlazCode clears its own leftover text and sends the full message as a file.
**Commands run again:** the leftover draft no longer blocks every later command.
**Less waiting:** after one stalled attempt, later long messages go straight to the file method.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Platform/browser regressions passed. Text you typed is never cleared. Not yet tested on a live Notion account.
